insights.summary: Daily summary email includes patient full name and DOB despite PHI redaction being enabled.
insights.quote: The daily summary email is including the patient's full name and date of birth, even though we have PHI redaction turned on.

insights.summary: Wants summaries that omit patient identifiers entirely (new vs existing patient only).
insights.quote: Could the summaries for our offices leave out patient identifiers entirely and just say new patient or existing patient?
